results.title: Duplicate line sections report different capacity
results.explanation: The same place has two different hosting capacity values.

results.title: Capacity value is negative
results.explanation: Hosting capacity cannot be below zero.

results.title: Minimum capacity is greater than maximum capacity
results.explanation: The lower value is higher than the upper value, which cannot be right.

results.title: Analysis over 6 months old, with new solar connected since
results.explanation: At least 0.5 MW of new solar or other generation joined this feeder after the analysis, so the value may now be too high.

results.title: Feeder listed but substation missing
results.explanation: Every feeder starts at a substation, but the utility does not name it here.

results.title: Feeder listed but phase missing
results.explanation: Every working line has a phase, which decides what kind of project can connect.

results.title: Feeder listed but capacity value missing
results.explanation: The line belongs to a named feeder, but the utility published no value for it.

results.title: Same line section published more than once
results.explanation: The same stretch of line appears more than once in the utility's data.

results.title: Substation listed but feeder missing
results.explanation: A line that names its substation should also name its feeder.

results.title: Line section has no hosting capacity analysis
results.explanation: Shown as a dashed gray line on the map. This is about coverage, not an error.

results.title: Published capacity is exactly 0 MW
results.explanation: This can mean there is no room, or that the line was not analyzed. The data does not say which.
